```{r setup}
#! include: false

library(breakaway)
library(treemapify)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

output_dir <- here("results", "species_estimation_qmd", "20260909")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

set.seed(42)

# Colour Brewer paired palette
colour_brewer <- setNames(append(as.list(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")), c("#737373", "#FFFFFF", "#000000")), c("blue", "darkblue", "green", "darkgreen", "red", "darkred", "orange", "darkorange", "purple", "darkpurple", "yellow", "brown", "grey", "white", "black"))

# Paul Tol's vibrant palette - colourblind friendly
vibrant_colours <- c("#CC3311", "#0077BB", "#009988", "#EE3377", "#EE7733", "#33BBEE")
# Paul Tol's muted palette - plus 3 extras
muted_colours <- c("#882255", "#332288", "#DDCC77", "#117733", "#88CCEE", "#CC6677", "#44AA99", "#999933", "#AA4499", "#BBBBBB", "#EE7733", "#CC3311")
# Paul Tol's bright palette - colourblind friendly
bright_colours <- c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44", "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB")

cluster_type_levels <- c("genome_linked", "multi_sample", "multi_hit", "single_singleton")
```

```{r wrangling}
input_dir <- here("results", "species_estimation", "20260704")
wrangling_path <- here(output_dir, "wrangling.RData")
if (file.exists(wrangling_path)) {
  load(wrangling_path)
  print("Using prior wrangling")
} else {
  summary <- read_tsv(here(input_dir, "summary.tsv"))

  cluster_summary <- tibble(
      marker = list.dirs(here(input_dir), full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    filter(str_detect(marker, "^S3.")) %>%
    mutate(
      tsv_path = here(input_dir, marker, str_c(marker, ".tsv")),
      data = map(tsv_path, function(path) {
        marker_name <- basename(dirname(path))
        read_tsv(path) %>%
        left_join(
          read_tsv(here(input_dir, marker_name, "globdb_matches.tsv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE,
                   col_select = c(id, globdb_status)),
          by = "id"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          # rep_status = factor(unknown, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("GlobDB", "unknown")),
          # rep_hits = hits,
          # cluster_n = cluster_size,
          cluster_samples = n_samples,
          cluster_status = globdb_status == "confirmed",
          cluster_status = factor(cluster_status, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("GlobDB", "unknown")),
          # cluster_max_hits = max_hits,
          cluster_total_hits = total_hits,
          cluster_type = case_when(
            cluster_status == "GlobDB" ~ "genome_linked",
            cluster_samples > 1 ~ "multi_sample",
            cluster_total_hits > 1 ~ "multi_hit",
            TRUE ~ "single_singleton"
          ),
        ) %>%
        group_by(cluster_type) %>%
        summarise(
          n = n(),
          size_min = min(cluster_samples),
          size_max = max(cluster_samples),
          size_median = median(cluster_samples),
          total_hits_min = min(cluster_total_hits),
          total_hits_max = max(cluster_total_hits),
          total_hits_median = median(cluster_total_hits),
          .groups = "drop"
          )
      }),
    ) %>%
    select(-c(tsv_path)) %>%
    unnest(data)

  processed_summary_path <- here(input_dir, "species_count_complete.tsv")
  cumulative_year <- read_tsv(processed_summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(stratum %in% c("year", "human_per_year")) %>%
    group_by(marker, stratum, stratum_value) %>%
    summarise(species = sum(species_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    transmute(marker,
              cohort = if_else(stratum == "year", "all", "human-gut"),
              year = as.integer(stratum_value), species)

  save.image(wrangling_path)
}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--- Sample-by-cluster incidence data for rarefaction curves
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build a sample-by-cluster incidence table for the rarefaction and cumulative
# plots.  The processing pipeline treats each cluster as one species.
incidence_path <- here(output_dir, "sample_cluster_incidence.RData")
if (file.exists(incidence_path)) {
  load(incidence_path)
} else {
  metadata_path <- here("results", "sample_metadata", "sandpiper_39_sample_metadata_with_organism.tsv")
  sample_metadata <- read_tsv(metadata_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(sample = acc, year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)), organism)

  read_marker_incidence <- function(marker) {
    cluster_path <- here(input_dir, marker, "clusters.tsv")
    fasta_path <- here(input_dir, "collated_fastas", str_c(marker, ".fasta"))
    clusters <- read_tsv(cluster_path, col_names = c("member", "species"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(member = str_replace_all(member, "-", "N")) %>% distinct()
    lines <- readLines(fasta_path)
    headers <- which(str_starts(lines, ">"))
    end <- c(headers[-1] - 1L, length(lines))
    tibble(
      sample = map_chr(seq_along(headers), ~ str_split(lines[headers[.x]], "\\|", simplify = TRUE)[2]),
      sequence = map2_chr(headers, end, ~ str_replace_all(paste0(lines[(.x + 1L):.y], collapse = ""), "-", "N"))
    ) %>%
      left_join(clusters, by = c("sequence" = "member")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(species)) %>% distinct(sample, species)
  }

  incidence <- map_dfr(cluster_summary$marker %>% unique(), ~
    read_marker_incidence(.x) %>% mutate(marker = .x)) %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample")

  save(incidence, sample_metadata, file = incidence_path)
}
```

```{r stats}
# Min/max/median OTU and cluster counts
summary %>%
  summarise(
    min_otus = min(num_otus),
    max_otus = max(num_otus),
    median_otus = median(num_otus),
    min_clusters = min(num_clusters),
    max_clusters = max(num_clusters),
    median_clusters = median(num_clusters)
  )

# Cluster types
cluster_summary %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster_type,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Cluster type proportions
cluster_summary %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster_type,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ .x / total)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(genome_linked, multi_sample, multi_hit, single_singleton),
    names_to = "cluster_type",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_type) %>%
  summarise(
    min_prop = min(prop),
    max_prop = max(prop),
    median_prop = median(prop),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r analysis}
# Stacked barplot of cluster types per marker
cluster_summary %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n, prop) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(n, prop), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    marker = factor(marker),
    marker_n = str_extract(marker, "(?<=S3.)\\d+") %>% as.integer(),
    cluster_type = factor(cluster_type, levels = cluster_type_levels)
    ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(marker, marker_n), y = value, fill = cluster_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = muted_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Marker") +
  ylab("Count / Proportion") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cluster_type_barplot.png"), width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600)

# Treemap of cluster types as a median proportion across markers
cluster_summary %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    cluster_type = factor(cluster_type, levels = cluster_type_levels)
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cluster_type) %>%
  summarise(median_prop = median(prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(area = median_prop, fill = cluster_type, label = cluster_type)) +
  treemapify::geom_treemap() +
  treemapify::geom_treemap_text(
    colour = "white", place = "centre",
    grow = FALSE, reflow = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = muted_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cluster_type_treemap.png"), width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 600)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--- Sample rarefaction and cumulative-year figures
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Species accumulation as a function of the fraction of samples included.
# Ten random permutations at each fraction provide a light uncertainty band.
rarefaction <- function(x, cohort_name, fractions = seq(.1, 1, .1), replicates = 10) {
  samples <- x %>% filter(cohort == cohort_name) %>% distinct(sample) %>% pull(sample)
  if (!length(samples)) return(tibble())
  map_dfr(fractions, function(fraction) {
    n <- max(1L, ceiling(length(samples) * fraction))
    map_dfr(seq_len(replicates), function(rep) {
      selected <- sample(samples, n)
      tibble(fraction = fraction, replicate = rep,
             species = n_distinct(x$species[x$sample %in% selected]))
    })
  }) %>% mutate(cohort = cohort_name)
}

incidence_cohorts <- incidence %>%
  mutate(cohort = if_else(organism == "human gut metagenome", "human-gut", "all"))
rarefaction_data <- map_dfr(sort(unique(incidence_cohorts$marker)), function(marker_name) {
  x <- filter(incidence_cohorts, marker == marker_name)
  bind_rows(rarefaction(x, "all"), rarefaction(x, "human-gut")) %>%
    mutate(marker = marker_name)
})

rarefaction_plot <- rarefaction_data %>%
  group_by(marker, cohort, fraction) %>%
  summarise(mean_species = mean(species),
            lower = quantile(species, .025), upper = quantile(species, .975), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(fraction, mean_species, colour = cohort, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = .18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(.1, 1, .1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of samples", y = "Species observed", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_cowplot() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "sample_rarefaction.png"), rarefaction_plot,
       width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)

cumulative_year_plot <- cumulative_year %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, species, colour = cohort)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) + geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Collection year (cumulative through year)", y = "Species observed", colour = NULL) +
  theme_cowplot() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cumulative_year_species.png"), cumulative_year_plot,
       width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r richness}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--- Richness estimates for all samples and human-gut samples
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
richness_input <- read_tsv(processed_summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
richness_markers <- sort(unique(richness_input$marker))

get_frequency_table <- function(marker_name, cohort_name) {
  stratum_name <- if (cohort_name == "all") "all" else "human_all"
  richness_input %>%
    filter(marker == marker_name, stratum == stratum_name,
           stratum_value == "all") %>%
    select(sample_count, species_count) %>%
    rename(frequency = sample_count, count = species_count) %>%
    arrange(frequency)
}

run_richness_method <- function(marker_name, cohort_name, method) {
  frequencies <- get_frequency_table(marker_name, cohort_name)
  if (!nrow(frequencies)) return(tibble())
  estimate <- method(frequencies)
  tibble(
    marker = marker_name,
    cohort = cohort_name,
    estimate = unname(estimate$estimate),
    error = if (!is.null(estimate$error)) unname(estimate$error) else NA_real_,
    model = if (!is.null(estimate$model)) as.character(estimate$model) else NA_character_
  )
}

richness_results <- map_dfr(c("all", "human-gut"), function(cohort_name) {
  map_dfr(richness_markers, function(marker_name) {
    frequencies <- get_frequency_table(marker_name, cohort_name)
    if (!nrow(frequencies)) return(tibble())
    breakaway_result <- breakaway(frequencies)
    sample_result <- sample_richness(frequencies)
    nof1_result <- breakaway_nof1(frequencies)
    f1 <- frequencies$count[frequencies$frequency == 1]
    f2 <- frequencies$count[frequencies$frequency == 2]
    f3 <- frequencies$count[frequencies$frequency == 3]
    tibble(
      marker = marker_name,
      cohort = cohort_name,
      breakaway_estimate = unname(breakaway_result$estimate),
      breakaway_error = unname(breakaway_result$error),
      breakaway_model = as.character(breakaway_result$model),
      observed_estimate = unname(sample_result$estimate),
      nof1_estimate = unname(nof1_result$estimate),
      nof1_error = unname(nof1_result$error),
      nof1_model = as.character(nof1_result$model),
      f1_f2_ratio = if (length(f1) && length(f2) && f2 != 0) f1 / f2 else NA_real_,
      f2_f3_ratio = if (length(f2) && length(f3) && f3 != 0) f2 / f3 else NA_real_
    )
  })
})

write_tsv(richness_results, here(output_dir, "richness_estimates.tsv"))

richness_plot_data <- richness_results %>%
  select(marker, cohort, breakaway_estimate, breakaway_error,
         observed_estimate, nof1_estimate, nof1_error) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(marker, cohort),
    names_to = c("method", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(estimate|error)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(
    method,
    breakaway = "Estimated total",
    observed = "Observed",
    nof1 = "Estimated total (singletons excluded)"
  ))

richness_plot <- richness_plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = marker, y = estimate, colour = method)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = .6), size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(0, estimate - error), ymax = estimate + error),
    position = position_dodge(width = .6), width = .2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Marker", y = "Richness estimate", colour = "Method") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "richness_estimates.png"), richness_plot,
       width = 15, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
